Package org.apache.beam.sdk.schemas.logicaltypes

@DefaultAnnotation(org.checkerframework.checker.nullness.qual.NonNull.class) package org.apache.beam.sdk.schemas.logicaltypes
A set of common LogicalTypes for use with schemas.

For further details, see the documentation for each class in this package.
